---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement for LOKI
title: '[Feature] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem Statement

A clear and concise description of the problem this feature would solve.
Example: "I'm always frustrated when..."

## Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you'd like. Be as specific as possible.

## Alternative Solutions

Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Use Case

Describe the specific use case(s) this feature would enable.

## Implementation Notes

If you have technical suggestions for implementation, describe them here.
Consider:
- Which component(s) would be affected? (orchestration, interface, agents, tools)
- Would this require new dependencies?
- Are there existing patterns in the codebase to follow?

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or references about the feature request here.
